title: Genomic Data Pre-processing Explorer
audience: Basic science learners cleaning simulated genomic feature data before AI modeling.
objectives: Inspect raw and processed genomic feature tables.
Apply winsorization to reduce outlier impact.
Impute missing values with a chosen strategy.
Scale features and compare raw versus processed distributions.

sections.name: Raw and Processed Data
sections.purpose: Compare table previews before and after preprocessing.

sections.name: Box Plot
sections.purpose: Compare feature distributions before and after preprocessing.

chatbot_guidance: Explain winsorization, imputation, and scaling in plain terms.
Help learners interpret why outliers distort boxplots.
Point learners to compare raw and processed tables before changing settings.
